sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000140-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Blue Ridge Medical Group 140 on July 4, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 1 rebate of 2%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 600 Influenza doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: countered by the Customer.
